properties.notes: The site comprises a mix of uses including commercial, equestrian and grazing land. The western portion of the site contains a number of buildings and hardstanding. Bounded by residential development and the A20 to the north, and open countryside to the west, south and east. Mature trees line the southern boundary of the site.
